evidence.definition: Age dependency ratio is the ratio of dependents--people younger than 15 or older than 64--to the working-age population--those ages 15-64. Data are shown as the proportion of dependents per 100 working-age population.
evidence.source_organization:
World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division;
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)
